# 🤖 CapGuru

> **Category**: `CAPTCHA Solvers`  
> **Official Vendor API Docs**: [https://cap.guru/api-docs/](https://cap.guru/api-docs/)

High-speed AI and human-assisted CAPTCHA solving service supporting reCAPTCHA, Turnstile, hCaptcha, FunCaptcha, and image captchas.
